visual_design_recommendations.badge_style: Clean, professional icons or minimal text badges
visual_design_recommendations.size: Consistent sizing within category groups (30-60px height typical)
visual_design_recommendations.color_treatment: Match brand palette; consider subtle color for less prominent badges
visual_design_recommendations.hover_effect: Optional tooltip with explanation on hover
visual_design_recommendations.mobile_consideration: Reduce number shown on mobile; stack vertically or use carousel
visual_design_recommendations.accessibility: Alt text for all badge images; sufficient contrast; screen reader friendly

implementation_checklist.inventory_existing: List all current trust signals and credentials
implementation_checklist.source_official_assets: Download official logos from awarding/certifying bodies
implementation_checklist.create_custom_assets: Design consistent treatment for text-based claims
implementation_checklist.determine_placement: Map each badge to optimal page location(s)
implementation_checklist.implement_with_testing: Deploy and A/B test if possible
implementation_checklist.maintain_currency: Update awards annually; refresh credentials as renewed
implementation_checklist.avoid_overload: Too many badges dilutes impact - prioritize top 5-8
